title: First vs Last Transaction Amount
scenario: Compare the amount of the first transaction and the last transaction for every account.
tableSchema: transactions (acc_id INT, amount NUMERIC, ts TIMESTAMP)
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT acc_id, FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY acc_id ORDER BY ts) AS first_amt, LAST_VALUE(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY acc_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_amt FROM transactions;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (acc_id INT, amount NUMERIC, ts TIMESTAMP);
